_comment: Booking-flow cases, in all three languages. Each one names a snapshot in tests/snapshots/ (captured from the real practice pages with the real serializer via the popup's Save page snapshot button), the goal the user spoke, and which recipe step's hint to pass in. Expected names are matched with Daari's own scorer at >= 80, so 'Pay' matches 'Pay ₹378' and the fare can change without breaking the test.
